Why should we live there?

It is a lot safer than Mexico, salaries are much higher, and it has the best nature in Europe: volcanoes, glaciers and the northern lights.

Our recommendation

Move there: Iceland!

Three reasons, one from each of us.

1
Areli Olvera

The main reason is housing: rent is more expensive, but people can afford it because it uses only 44% of a salary in Iceland (86% in Mexico).

2
Elizabeth Tirado

Iceland is a lot safer than Mexico: it is number 1 in the world, and Mexico is number 135.

3
Juan Pablo Morales

The biggest advantage is the salary (almost 7 times higher). The biggest problem is the long, cold and dark winter.
